title: Python DIO parser accepts truncated 20 to 23 byte base object
description: Rule 7 and versioning correctness rereview: python RPL messages declares DIO_BASE_LENGTH as 20 although the RFC 6550 DIO base is 24 bytes. DIO.from_bytes therefore accepts 20 to 23 bytes, pads the missing DODAGID suffix with zeros, and can manufacture a valid-looking scope or version-policy input from a truncated packet. Require exactly at least 24 bytes before parsing and never pad wire data. Add 0 through 23 truncation cases plus exact 24-byte and root option round trips, and keep Python and Rust rejection behavior aligned.
